Operator: Good morning, and welcome to the Halvorsen Components third quarter earnings call. All participants are in listen-only mode. I will now hand the call to Marta Lindqvist, our chief executive.
Marta Lindqvist: Thank you, operator, and good morning everyone. Revenue grew eight percent this quarter, driven by strong demand for our industrial sensors.
Marta Lindqvist: We also opened our new plant in Poland, which is on budget and ahead of schedule.
Tomas Okafor: Thanks, Marta. Gross margin was thirty eight percent, up two points, and we ended the quarter with strong cash flow.
Marta Lindqvist: Looking ahead, we now expect full year revenue growth of seven to nine percent, and we are raising our outlook for the sensor business.
Operator: Our first question comes from Priya Raman at Fenwick Securities.
Priya Raman: Thanks for taking my question. Can you say more about demand from automotive customers?
Marta Lindqvist: Automotive orders rose twelve percent, and our backlog is at a record high.
Operator: Next is Daniel Whitcombe from Corvale Capital.
Daniel Whitcombe: Good morning. How much of the margin improvement came from pricing rather than lower material costs?
Tomas Okafor: About half came from pricing, and the rest from lower material costs and better factory utilisation.
Operator: The next question is from Sofia Marchetti at Larkspur Research.
Sofia Marchetti: Will the new plant in Poland change your capital spending next year? And do you expect any delay in the ramp up?
Tomas Okafor: Capital spending should stay around four percent of revenue, and we see no delay in the ramp up.
Operator: The next question is from Hugo Brandt at Eastgate Partners.
Hugo Brandt: Could you update us on share buybacks this quarter?
Tomas Okafor: We bought back two million dollars of shares and plan to continue.
Speaker 1: Sorry, could you repeat that last number?
Operator: One more question, from Anika Sen at Eastgate Partners.
Anika Sen: Quick one on tariffs. Do you expect any impact next year?
Tomas Okafor: We expect a small impact, well inside our guidance.
Marta Lindqvist: Thank you all for joining us today.
Tomas Okafor: Thanks everyone, goodbye.
